topic: 非谓语动词专项突破（Non-finite Verbs: Infinitives, Gerunds & Participles）
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：非谓语动词就像是动词变身成的“斜杠青年”！在一个完整的英语句子中，只能有一个真正的“大老大”（谓语动词）。如果还想加入其他动词，它们就不能以原形直接出场，必须变身为不定式(to do)、动名词(doing)或分词(doing/done)，在句中兼职充当主语、宾语、定语或状语。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：一句不容二谓语，非谓变身来助力！加to常表“目的与将来”，加ing常表“进行与习惯”，过去分词done表“被动与完成”。
3. 【中小学生易错点】：
   ① 介词后误用动词原形：记住所有介词（如 of, at, in, by, about, look forward to 中的 to）后面必须跟动名词(doing)。
   ② 动名词与不定式混淆：如 stop to do（停下来去干另一件事）vs. stop doing（停止正在干的事）。
   ③ 分词状语逻辑主语失一致：做中学压轴题时，分词动作的发起者必须是主句的主语，主动用 -ing，被动用 -ed。
4. 【经典例句】：
   ① She decided to study hard for the upcoming exam.（她决定为即将到来的考试好好学习。—— 不定式做宾语，表将来动作）
   ② Tom is fond of playing computer games on weekends.（汤姆喜欢在周末玩电脑游戏。—— 介词 of 后用动名词）
   ③ Inspired by the teacher's words, the girl worked even harder.（受到老师话语的鼓舞，女孩更加努力了。—— 过去分词做状语，表被动与完成）

questions.question: My sister wants _____ a giant panda in the zoo this weekend.
questions.explanation: 考查 want 的用法。want to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“想要做某事”，后接动词不定式。

questions.question: Do you enjoy _____ English storybooks in your free time?
questions.explanation: 考查 enjoy 的用法。enjoy doing sth. 意为“喜欢/享受做某事”，后接动名词。

questions.question: The doctor advised my father _____ smoking for his health.
questions.explanation: 考查 advise 的用法。advise sb. to do sth. 意为“建议某人做某事”，后接带 to 的不定式做宾语补足语。

questions.question: Lucy went to the supermarket _____ some fresh apples.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式表目的。动词不定式 (to buy) 在句中充当目的状语，表示去超市的目的是买苹果。

questions.question: Thank you for _____ me with my English homework.
questions.explanation: 考查介词后接动名词。for 是介词，介词后面后接动词时必须使用动名词形式(doing)。

questions.question: My father promised _____ me a new bicycle on my birthday.
questions.explanation: 考查 promise 的用法。promise to do sth. 意为“承诺/答应做某事”，用不定式做宾语。

questions.question: The students practice _____ English aloud every morning.
questions.explanation: 考查 practice 的用法。practice doing sth. 意为“练习做某事”，后面必须跟动名词形式。

questions.question: It took us two hours _____ the local history museum yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查固定句型：It takes/took sb. time to do sth.（做某事花了某人多少时间），其中的 it 是形式主语，真正的主语是后置的动词不定式。

questions.question: Don't forget _____ off the light when you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: 考查 forget 的搭配差异。forget to do sth. 意为“别忘了去做某事（事情尚未做）”；forget doing 意为“忘了做过某事”。根据句意表示提醒离开时要记得关灯，故选 B。

questions.question: They decided _____ a movie together after finishing homework.
questions.explanation: 考查 decide 的用法。decide to do sth. 意为“决定做某事”，用不定式做宾语。

questions.question: What about _____ a picnic in the park this Saturday?
questions.explanation: 考查提建议句型中的非谓语动词。what about... / how about... 后接动词时，必须接动名词形式(doing)。

questions.question: The old man was tired, so he stopped _____ on the bench by the road.
questions.explanation: 考查 stop 的用法对比。stop to do sth. 意为“停下来去干另一件事”；stop doing sth. 意为“停止当前正在做的事”。老爷爷累了，所以停下来去休息，用 stop to rest。

questions.question: My little brother is afraid of _____ in the dark room alone.
questions.explanation: 考查 be afraid of 的用法。of 为介词，介词后接动词须用动名词 sleeping。

questions.question: Miss Li asked the students _____ quiet in the reading room.
questions.explanation: 考查 ask 的用法。ask sb. to do sth. 意为“要求/叫某人做某事”，后接动词不定式做补语。

questions.question: I prefer _____ to music in my free time rather than playing games.
questions.explanation: 考查 prefer doing A to doing B 结构。此处句型省略了后面的介词 to，表偏好某事，常用动名词形式做宾语。

questions.question: _____ for three hours in the heavy rain, the tired traveler finally reached the village.
questions.explanation: 考查分词完成式做时间状语。traveler 与 walk 是主谓关联（主动），且“在雨中走了三小时”发生在“到达村庄”之前，强调动作优先发生，故使用现在分词的完成式 Having walked。

questions.question: The ancient building _____ last century is now under repairs by the government.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词做后置定语。building 与 build 存在被动且已完成的关系，在此修饰 building，作后置定语相当于 which was built last century。

questions.question: With all the tasks _____ ahead of time, the team felt relieved and went celebrating.
questions.explanation: 考查 With 复合结构（With + 宾语 + 非谓语动词）。tasks 与 finish 之间是被动且已完成关系，故用过去分词 finished 充当宾语补足语。

questions.question: I heard someone _____ the violin downstairs when I entered the building.
questions.explanation: 考查感官动词 hear 的用法。hear sb. doing sth. 强调听到某人正在做某事（强调动作正在进行）；hear sb. do 强调听到整个过程。句中有 when I entered 这一时间点，强调正在拉小提琴，故选 C。

questions.question: _____ from the top of the mountain, the whole city looks particularly splendid at night.
questions.explanation: 考查过去分词做状语。句子主语是 the whole city（这座城市），它与 see 之间是被动关系（城市被观看），因此必须使用过去分词 Seen 作状语。

questions.question: The boy pretended _____ when his mother opened the bedroom door.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式的进行式。pretend to be doing sth. 表示“假装正在做某事”。妈妈推门时男孩正假装在睡觉，符合语境。

questions.question: She turned on the radio, _____ the quiet living room with classical music.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词做伴随/结果状语。开启收音机这一动作顺理成章地充盈了房间，使用现在分词 filling 表示自然伴随或结果。

questions.question: We are looking forward to _____ your confirmation email regarding the conference.
questions.explanation: 考查含介词 to 的固定短语。look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须跟动名词(doing)，容易误混为动词不定式符号。

questions.question: _____ to catch the early morning train, Mr. Jackson set his alarm clock for 5:00 a.m.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词做原因状语。主语 Mr. Jackson 与 hope 是主动关系（希望能赶上早班车），故使用现在分词 Hoping。

questions.question: The new subway line _____ next year will greatly shorten commuting time for citizens.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式的被动式做定语。由的时间状语 next year 可知动作尚未发生，且 subway line 与 complete 是被动关系，故使用不定式的被动形式 to be completed 表将来及被动。

questions.question: The suspect was seen _____ the bank with a black bag just before the police arrived.
questions.explanation: 考查感官动词被动语态中 to 的还原。主动语态中 see sb. do sth. 省略 to；变为被动语态 (be seen) 时，后面的动词不定式必须还原符号 to，即 be seen to do sth.。

questions.question: _____ all his money on the risky investment, the businessman had to rebuild his firm.
questions.explanation: 考查现在分词完成式做原因状语。businessman 与 lose 是主动关系，且“输掉所有钱”发生在“重建公司”之前，动作显现先后顺序，故选用 Having lost。

questions.question: It is no use _____ over split milk; we should focus on solutions instead.
questions.explanation: 考查固定句型：It is no use doing sth.（做某事是没有用的/徒劳的），句型中固定使用动名词做真正的主语。

questions.question: Weather _____, the outdoor graduation ceremony will be held as scheduled tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 考查独立主格结构。Weather permitting 是极为经典的独立主格短语，Weather 与 permit 之间是主动关联，用现在分词 permitting，意为“天气允许的话”。

questions.question: The manager regretted _____ the employees about the salary cut, as it caused lower morale.
questions.explanation: 考查 regret 的语义区别。regret to do sth. 遗憾/抱歉地要做某事（未做）；regret doing sth. 悔恨/后悔做过了某事（已做）。句意表示经理后悔“已经告知了”员工减薪的事，故选用动名词 informing。
